lines.en: I knock on Ayane's door and wait for-
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Ayane 的门，等着——
: 进来。

lines.en: Ayane opens the door less than two seconds after I knock which, in itself, isn't something to write home about.
lines.zh: 我敲门不到两秒，Ayane 就开了门——这本身没什么值得说的。

lines.en: In fact, one out of every three visits here normally starts the same exact way.
lines.zh: 事实上，我每来三次里就有一次是一模一样的开场。
不过这次不一样。

lines.en: This time, there is no excitement.
lines.zh: 这次，没有兴奋。

lines.en: There's no rush to get as close to me as possible- nor energized advances or the hastened removal of our clothing.
lines.zh: 没有急着尽可能贴近我——没有元气满满的主动，也没有急匆匆地脱我们的衣服。

lines.en: Just a door that was opened a little too quickly-
lines.zh: 只有一扇开得稍微太快了的门——

lines.en: And the mess of a girl who was waiting behind it.
lines.zh: 和门后等着的一个乱糟糟的女孩。
: 是……我知道。

lines.en: : I look really ugly right now and I’m sorry you have to see me like this...
lines.zh: : 我现在看起来很丑，很抱歉你得看到我这个样子……
: 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I shouldn't be dragging you into-
lines.zh: : 因为我不该把你拖进——

lines.en: : No, I mean why are you apologizing?
lines.zh: : 不，我是说你为什么道歉？

lines.en: : Well...because you're going to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……因为你要跟我做爱。
: 而我……是这副样子……

lines.en: : You...are going to have sex with me...right?...
lines.zh: : 你……会跟我做爱……对吧？……

lines.en: : In this condition? Are you kidding?
lines.zh: : 这种状态？你开玩笑？
: 什么状态？我没事。

lines.en: : You're not fine, Ayane. Something is very obviously wrong. How long have you been crying? Your eyes are nearly swollen shut.
lines.zh: : 你不是没事，Ayane。很明显有什么不对。你哭了多久了？你的眼睛都快肿得睁不开了。

lines.en: : Do we really have to do this?
lines.zh: : 我们非得谈这个吗？

lines.en: : Yes, we do. Talk to me.
lines.zh: : 是的，非谈不可。跟我说。
: 我不想说。

lines.en: : That’s not fair and you know it.
lines.zh: : 那不公平，你心里清楚。

lines.en: : You can’t just keep hiding your-
lines.zh: : 你不能一直把自己的——
: 我怀孕了。
: 你刚才说什么？……
: 开玩笑的～
: 哈哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : That...lightened up the mood a little though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过……那把气氛缓和了一点，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you really think that's funny?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得那好笑？

lines.en: I feel nauseous- like my stomach is eating itself from the inside out and my heart is being pounded by a jackhammer.
lines.zh: 我觉得恶心——像我的胃在从里往外吃自己，而我的心被一台手提钻在敲。
: 抱歉……

lines.en: : I know that was kind of messed up...
lines.zh: : 我知道那有点过分……
: 有点？你开玩笑？

lines.en: : That's one of the absolute worst things that could possibly happen.
lines.zh: : 那是有可能发生的最糟的事之一。

lines.en: : Would it...really be that bad, though?...
lines.zh: : 不过……真有那么糟吗？……

lines.en: : Would what be that bad? Getting you pregnant?
lines.zh: : 什么有那么糟？让你怀孕？

lines.en: : Don’t you want to be a daddy?
lines.zh: : 你不想当爸爸吗？

lines.en: : You haven't even finished high school yet. Listen to yourself.
lines.zh: : 你高中都还没毕业。听听你自己在说什么。

lines.en: : I can drop out. I have money.
lines.zh: : 我可以退学。我有钱。

lines.en: : I think I'd make a good mom.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我会是个好妈妈。

lines.en: : We could raise a baby without any problems at all...
lines.zh: : 我们养个孩子完全不成问题……

lines.en: : It'd be...a wonderful life...where neither of us would have to hide our feelings anymore.
lines.zh: : 那会是……很棒的一生……在那儿我俩都不用再藏起自己的感情。

lines.en: : Is that what this is about?
lines.zh: : 这就是问题所在吗？

lines.en: : Are you really that torn up about keeping our relationship a secret? Because if this is a byproduct of that-
lines.zh: : 你真的这么纠结于保守我们关系的秘密？因为如果这是它的副产品——

lines.en: : No. I’m fine with keeping our relationship a secret, Sensei. I expected as much once we started getting more serious, and I have no intention of putting that in any real danger.
lines.zh: : 不。我对保守我们关系的秘密没意见，老师。我们开始变得更认真时我就料到了，我也没打算把它真的置于危险里。

lines.en: : I’ll admit that I’d be more than happy to tell the entire world if you wanted to, but that’s not why I'm crying.
lines.zh: : 我承认，如果你愿意，我会非常乐意告诉全世界。可那不是我哭的原因。

lines.en: : Then why are you crying? I can’t help you if you won’t tell me anything.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么哭？你什么都不告诉我，我就没法帮你。
: 因为……
: 因为你是我仅有的。

lines.en: : And yeah, I’m sure that makes me sound crazy and that you probably think I’m some sort of...psychopath who’s going to kill anyone for trying to get close to you-
lines.zh: : 而且对，我确信那让我听起来像个疯子，你大概觉得我是某种……为了任何想靠近你的人就要杀人的变态——

lines.en: : But I couldn’t care less about that.
lines.zh: : 可我一点都不在乎那个。

lines.en: : I couldn’t care less about any of them.
lines.zh: : 她们任何一个我都不在乎。
: 我对你上瘾。

lines.en: : And it’s your fault, too, you know!
lines.zh: : 而且那也是你的错，你知道吗！

lines.en: : It’s your fault for being so nice to me all the time.
lines.zh: : 是你一直对我那么好的错。

lines.en: : It's your fault that I fell in love.
lines.zh: : 是我爱上你的错。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault that you feel this way. Don’t try to pin this on me.
lines.zh: : 你有这种感觉不是我的错。别想把这赖到我头上。

lines.en: : That...sounded a little more harsh than I wanted it to. I didn't mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来比我想说的要刻薄一点。我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : What I’m trying to say is that maybe you’ve only gotten this attached to me because you were desperate to.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，也许你只是太渴望有人了，才对我依恋到这个地步。

lines.en: : Maybe you only feel this way because you think I'm ready to just accept all of the parts of you that aren't perfect.
lines.zh: : 也许你只是因为觉得我已经准备好接受你所有不完美的部分，才有这种感觉。

lines.en: : Wait...are you...saying that you...don’t accept those parts of me?...
lines.zh: : 等等……你是在说……你……不接受我那些部分？……

lines.en: : Most of them I don't have any issue with at all. I love how chaotic and unpredictable you can be.
lines.zh: : 大部分我一点意见都没有。我爱你可以多混乱、多不可预测。

lines.en: : But it’s not even remotely fair for you to just keep all of this inside and then just let it out whenever it’s convenient for you.
lines.zh: : 可你把这些全憋在心里、然后只在对你方便的时候放出来，这一点都不公平。
: 那……不是我在做的事……

lines.en: : Then what are you doing, Ayane? Talk to me.
lines.zh: : 那你在做什么，Ayane？跟我说。

lines.en: Ayane’s eyes move away from me and navigate to the opposite side of the room.
lines.zh: Ayane 的目光从我身上移开，落到房间的另一头。

lines.en: It’s clear that she’s not used to being on her back foot like this, but I'm not really sure what she was expecting when she let me inside.
lines.zh: 很显然她不习惯这样处于下风，不过我真不确定她放我进来的时候在期待什么。

lines.en: I know she’s not consciously trying to take advantage of me, but I need to show her that I’m not just some tool she can use to make herself feel whole.
lines.zh: 我知道她不是有意识地想利用我，可我得让她明白：我不是她用来让自己完整的某种工具。

lines.en: I think long and hard about that last sentence in the midst of a conversational gap, but decide to break the silence on my own when I see where my thoughts are headed.
lines.zh: 在一段对话的空档里，我对最后那句话想了很久，可当我看到自己的思路往哪儿走时，我决定自己打破沉默。

lines.en: : Where did this all come from? It's just so...random.
lines.zh: : 这一切从哪儿来的？就这么……突然。
: 你什么意思？……

lines.en: : It's not like this has never happened before...
lines.zh: : 又不是从没发生过……

lines.en: : Do you remember the first time I broke down in front of you?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我第一次在你面前崩溃吗？
对。

lines.en: Ayane and I go back much further than the time I’ve spent with her here.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我之间的渊源，远比我在这儿跟她度过的时间要长。

lines.en: There are years worth of memories stored somewhere inside of this body attempting to revolve around her only to be forced away by a foreign source of gravity.
lines.zh: 这具身体里存着好几年的记忆，试图绕着她转，却被一股外来的引力强行推开。

lines.en: None of them belong to me, and yet I wish to access them regardless.
lines.zh: 它们没有一样属于我，可我还是想拿到。

lines.en: Nearly all of the memories I possess are little things like play-fighting at the dojo or brainstorming names for the children we’ll never have.
lines.zh: 我拥有的记忆几乎都是小事，比如在道场里闹着玩地打架，或者给永远不会有的孩子起名。

lines.en: There are some bigger ones in the mix, sure. But I can't recollect them without having to force away an erection.
lines.zh: 当然也掺着一些更大的。可不先压下一个勃起，我没法回忆它们。

lines.en: I don’t deserve any of this.
lines.zh: 这些我一样都不配。
可我还是要。

lines.en: I want to remember what I was never there for.
lines.zh: 我想记起我从没在场的事。

lines.en: I want to see it as if I was.
lines.zh: 我想像自己当时在场那样看见它。
: 你记不得，是吧？

lines.en: : It’s fine....Of course you wouldn’t remember something as silly as that.
lines.zh: : 没事……你当然不会记得像那种小事。

lines.en: : But I remember it vividly. It was probably the moment I fell in love with you.
lines.zh: : 可我记得清清楚楚。那大概是我爱上你的那一刻。
: 我想听听……

lines.en: : I had just turned eleven...and my mom had moved out a few weeks earlier.
lines.zh: : 我刚满十一岁……而我妈几周前搬出去了。

lines.en: : I came over to your house to play with Ami and we were watching some old gameshow on TV.
lines.zh: : 我去你家跟 Ami 玩，我们正在看电视上某个老游戏节目。

lines.en: : You were cooking us dinner...or at least trying to...
lines.zh: : 你在给我们做晚饭……或者至少在试着做……
: 可是，然后……

lines.en: : When you finally finished...you brought over this...huge plate of super-burnt fried chicken, and I just...
lines.zh: : 等你终于弄完……你端过来这……一大盘烤得焦黑的炸鸡，然后我就……
: 我失控了。

lines.en: : I started crying like a...fucking baby out of nowhere and you and Ami had no idea what to do.
lines.zh: : 我像个……操蛋的婴儿一样毫无预兆地哭起来，你和 Ami 完全不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : And so you put the chicken down right there on the floor...and you wrapped your arms around me...
lines.zh: : 于是你就把那盘鸡放在地上……然后张开手臂抱住我……

lines.en: : I can still remember how large they felt...
lines.zh: : 我还记得它们感觉有多大……

lines.en: : And you told me...you told me that everything would be okay. And that you would always be there for me.
lines.zh: : 而你告诉我……你告诉我一切都会没事的。你会永远在我身边。

lines.en: : Then Ami started crying too because she was confused. And so she joined in and it was just this big, tight group-hug.
lines.zh: : 然后 Ami 也因为困惑跟着哭了。于是她也加入进来，就变成了这个又大又紧的群抱。

lines.en: : You never asked me any questions about why I was crying, but it was because your poor attempt at making fried chicken reminded me of my mom.
lines.zh: : 你从没问我为什么哭，可那是因为你那糟糕的炸鸡让我想起了我妈。

lines.en: : And how, before we had any money, we'd eat frozen food all the time.
lines.zh: : 以及，在我们有钱之前，我们一直吃冷冻食品。

lines.en: : My mom was never good at cooking. It was always my dad’s job.
lines.zh: : 我妈从来不擅长做饭。那一直是我爸的活。
: 可现在呢？……

lines.en: : My dad won’t even look at me anymore...
lines.zh: : 我爸连看都不看我一眼了……

lines.en: : And I haven’t talked to my mom in years...
lines.zh: : 而我好几年没跟我妈说过话了……

lines.en: : And I know I’m dumping a lot on you out of nowhere right now, but when you stand there and look at me like that, I can’t help it!
lines.zh: : 我知道我这是毫无预兆地往你身上倒一大堆东西，可当你站在那儿那样看着我的时候，我忍不住！

lines.en: : Yes, I have friends. And yes, they’re all very nice. But no one looks after me anymore!
lines.zh: : 对，我有朋友。对，她们都很好。可再没人照顾我了！
: 而且……
: 而且我还小！

lines.en: : I still need to be looked after!
lines.zh: : 我还需要被照顾！

lines.en: : I'm not ready to do everything on my own yet!
lines.zh: : 我还没准备好一个人扛所有事！

lines.en: : I can only be so strong, Sensei! I need help! I need help with all sorts of things!
lines.zh: : 我只能坚强到这个程度，老师！我需要帮助！我在各种事上都需要帮助！

lines.en: : How am I supposed to keep myself together when I'm cracking a little more each day?!
lines.zh: : 当我一天比一天裂得更厉害时，我要怎么把自己撑住？！
一切突然通了。

lines.en: Ayane isn’t just obsessed with me because she’s in love with me.
lines.zh: Ayane 对我如此着迷，不只是因为她爱我。

lines.en: She needs a father figure in her life now that hers has left her behind.
lines.zh: 她父亲把她抛下了，所以她现在生命里需要一个父亲形象。
她选了我。

lines.en: And I've been too preoccupied with trying to stick my dick inside of her to realize that.
lines.zh: 而我一直忙着想把我的鸡巴塞进她里面，没意识到这一点。
一切突然通了。

lines.en: : So...yeah. That’s why I was crying. Normal Ayane-stuff.
lines.zh: : 所以……对。那就是我哭的原因。普通的 Ayane 式破事。
: 我只是……很想你。

lines.en: : Do you want to move into my dorm room, too? Is that allowed?
lines.zh: : 你要不要也搬进我宿舍房间？那允许吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think the[school] would like that very much, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我觉得[school]不会太乐意，Ayane。

lines.en: : What if we dressed you up like a girl and made you wear baggy clothes to hide all of your muscles? Would that work?
lines.zh: : 那要是我们把你打扮成女孩、让你穿宽松衣服遮住你所有肌肉呢？那样行吗？

lines.en: : I have a feeling that wouldn’t work either.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉那也不成。

lines.en: : Ugh. Today just keeps getting worse.
lines.zh: : 呃。今天真是越来越糟了。

lines.en: : Would it be good enough to just keep coming here and spending time with you whenever possible?
lines.zh: : 那「只要有空就来这儿陪你」够不够好？

lines.en: : Good enough? No. But I'll accept it.
lines.zh: : 够好？不够。不过我接受。

lines.en: : You should just delete all of the plans in your calendar for the next year and come here every day from now on. I kind of need you.
lines.zh: : 你干脆把未来一年的日程全删了，从现在起每天都来吧。我挺需要你的。

lines.en: I try to smile at Ayane and forget to tell her that, in a weird way, I think I need her too.
lines.zh: 我试着对 Ayane 笑一下，却忘了告诉她：在某种意义上，我想我也需要她。

lines.en: Sure, I already have Ami as what I'd probably call the central figure of importance in my life, but who says I can’t have two?
lines.zh: 当然，我已经有 Ami 作为我生命里大概可以称作最重要的人。可谁说我不能有两个？

lines.en: Ayane needs a guardian just as much as she does.
lines.zh: Ayane 需要一个监护人，跟她需要一个父亲形象一样多。

lines.en: And even if the two of us aren’t related, I can’t just not want to take care of Ayane after hearing all of that.
lines.zh: 而且哪怕我俩没有血缘，听了那些之后，我不可能不想照顾 Ayane。

lines.en: I'm a horrible person, yes. But I’m not heartless.
lines.zh: 我是个糟糕的人，对。可我不是没有心。

lines.en: I need someone like Ayane to remind me of that from time to time.
lines.zh: 我需要像 Ayane 这样的人，时不时提醒我这一点。

lines.en: : Well, I can’t guarantee I'll come every day...But, like I said, I’ll come as much as I can.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不能保证每天都来……不过像我说的，我会尽可能常来。

lines.en: : Then...if you’re not going to come here every day, can you at least...
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你不能每天都来，至少你能不能……

lines.en: : Isn’t Sana going to be home any minute now?
lines.zh: : Sana 不是马上就要回来了吗？

lines.en: : So? It’s just Sana. She’s not going to tell anybody.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？只是 Sana 而已。她不会告诉任何人。

lines.en: I don’t think that’s really the issue here...
lines.zh: 我觉得那不是真正的问题所在……

lines.en: : Ayane...I don’t know if that’s a good idea.
lines.zh: : Ayane……我不知道那是不是个好主意。

lines.en: : Please, [ayanemaster]? I know I'm ugly right now, but you can have sex with me under the covers if you want.
lines.zh: : 求你了，[ayanemaster]？我知道我现在很丑，不过你愿意的话可以在被子里跟我做爱。

lines.en: : I’m not going to have sex with you when you look like you’ve just come back from a funeral.
lines.zh: : 我不会在你看起来像刚从葬礼回来的时候跟你做爱。

lines.en: : Okay, no sex. But please just sleep next to me tonight and I’ll never ask you for another favor again.
lines.zh: : 好，不做爱。不过请今晚就睡在我旁边，我以后再也不求你别的了。

lines.en: : I somehow doubt you'd even be able to make it through the rest of the night without asking for another favor.
lines.zh: : 我有点怀疑你连今晚剩下的时间都撑不过不求下一个。

lines.en: Sana will be home soon...but I feel like leaving Ayane behind might just wind up hurting her even more...
lines.zh: Sana 很快就回来了……可我觉得把 Ayane 丢下，说不定反而会更伤她……
我该怎么办？
留宿
: 我留宿。
: 真的？！你会？

lines.en: : Yes. But no [molesting] me under the blanket, got it?
lines.zh: : 会。不过不许在被子里[骚扰]我，明白？

lines.en: : Is it really molesting if both of us enjoy it?
lines.zh: : 如果我俩都享受，那真算骚扰吗？

lines.en: : I am not answering that question right now.
lines.zh: : 这个问题我现在不回答。

lines.en: : Fine! I’ll just be the little spoon so you don’t have to worry about me trying to grab your penis while you're not paying attention.
lines.zh: : 好！那我就当小勺，这样你就不用担心我趁你不注意抓你的阴茎了。
: 呃……谢了？

lines.en: Ayane falls asleep mere moments after getting into bed.
lines.zh: Ayane 上床后没一会儿就睡着了。

lines.en: Part of me thinks about leaving while I have the chance, but I decide against it on the off chance that she wakes up in the middle of the night for another episode.
lines.zh: 我有一部分想着趁还有机会就走，可我决定不这么做——万一她半夜又发作呢。

lines.en: She really does need me right now, and I can't hold that against her.
lines.zh: 她现在真的需要我，我不能拿这个跟她计较。

lines.en: And even though we’re bound to be discovered any moment-
lines.zh: 而且哪怕我们随时会被发现——
我不会后悔这个决定。
我确信 Sana 会理解的。
: 我回来了……
: 这……是什么？……
: 你在干什么？……

lines.en: I managed to stay awake long enough for Sana to get back because I felt like not having the chance to explain this would have made it ten times worse.
lines.zh: 我撑着没睡，等到了 Sana 回来——因为我觉得要没机会解释这事，只会让它糟上十倍。

lines.en: : Sana, this is absolutely not what it looks like.
lines.zh: : Sana，这绝对不是你看到的那样。
: 你为什么……在 Ayane 的床上？……
: 她不舒服。
: 她……怎么了？……

lines.en: : And...how does sleeping next to her fix it?...
lines.zh: : 而且……睡在她旁边怎么能治好？……
: 我……我真的很困惑……

lines.en: : I don’t blame you. It’s a weird situation.
lines.zh: : 我不怪你。这情况确实怪。

lines.en: : She's just been feeling a little down because of...family stuff, I guess.
lines.zh: : 她只是因为……大概家里的事，有点低落。
: 所以你只是……

lines.en: : Didn’t want her to be alone...
lines.zh: : 不想让她一个人……
: 而且……
: 而且……别的什么都没……发生？
: 一点都没有。
: 如果……如果你这么说的话……

lines.en: : I guess...this was bound to happen anyway...
lines.zh: : 我想……这事迟早会发生的……

lines.en: : Of course you wouldn't just...leave her alone...
lines.zh: : 你当然不会就这么……丢下她不管……

lines.en: : She looks like...she was crying a lot...
lines.zh: : 她看起来像……哭得很厉害……

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve never seen her like that before.
lines.zh: : 对。我从没见过她那样。
: 可怜的孩子……她一定累坏了……

lines.en: : I'm sure she is. And I'm sure you are too since you're just now getting back from work.
lines.zh: : 我确信她是。而我确信你也是——你这才刚下班回来。
: 是的……

lines.en: : I...don't know if I'll be able to get much sleep now, though...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道现在还能不能睡得着……

lines.en: : Just pretend I'm not here and I'm sure you'll be fine.
lines.zh: : 就当我不在这儿，我确信你会没事的。

lines.en: : I...don't think that will work very well...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得那不太行……

lines.en: : You won't know until you try.
lines.zh: : 不试你怎么知道。

lines.en: : Can you at least...turn around so I can put on my pajamas?...
lines.zh: : 你至少能……转过去让我换上睡衣吗？……

lines.en: : Just pretend I'm not here and I'm sure you'll be fine.
lines.zh: : 就当我不在这儿，我确信你会没事的。

lines.en: I reluctantly keep my eyes closed while Sana gets dressed because this really isn't the time to be letting my mind wander.
lines.zh: Sana 换衣服时，我不情愿地闭着眼——因为现在真不是让我心思乱飘的时候。

lines.en: Keeping my eyes open would also trigger a chain of events that would not be very ideal right now in my current role as the big spoon.
lines.zh: 睁着眼也会触发一连串事件，而那在我当前作为大勺的角色下，非常不理想。
什么？
我只是个人。

lines.en: It’s impossible to avoid thoughts like this- the same way it’s impossible to avoid things like loneliness or fear.
lines.zh: 回避这种念头是不可能的——就像回避孤独或恐惧这类东西一样不可能。

lines.en: We all bear witness to life's littlest atrocities. And sometimes, we may feel the need to lean on someone else for help.
lines.zh: 我们都见证着生命里那些最细小的暴行。而有时候，我们可能觉得需要靠在别人身上求助。

lines.en: So whether it be missing your family-
lines.zh: 所以不管是想念家人——
还是觉得自己不被需要——

lines.en: Or falling in love with a best friend’s uncle-
lines.zh: 还是爱上最好朋友的叔叔——
总会有明天。
只是有时候——

lines.en: It’s a little harder to get there.
lines.zh: 到那儿要难一点。
Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！
推进到周日出错
已经过去了 [totaldays] 天……

lines.en: Ayane and Sana are both gone when I wake up.
lines.zh: 我醒来时 Ayane 和 Sana 都不在了。

lines.en: There is a letter next to the bed that just says 'Thank you.'
lines.zh: 床边有封信，只写了「谢谢」。

lines.en: I guess I should figure out what I want to do today.
lines.zh: 我想我该搞清楚今天要干什么。
去个地方
我该去哪儿？

图书馆
足球场

lines.zh: 我想跟谁待着？
Miku
Karin

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Ayane...But I really should get going.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ayane……可我真该走了。

lines.en: : Really?...Even when I promised to be good?
lines.zh: : 真的？……哪怕我保证会乖？

lines.en: : It doesn’t have anything to do with you being good or not. I just can’t let another student see me sleeping in a bed with you.
lines.zh: : 跟你乖不乖没关系。我只是不能让另一个学生看见我跟你睡在一张床上。

lines.en: : Well...what if you slept on the floor? Would that be okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那要是你睡地上呢？那样行吗？

lines.en: : Wait, no! What if I slept on the floor? You’d stay then, right?
lines.zh: : 等等，不！那要是我睡地上呢？那样你就留下了，对吧？

lines.en: : Ayane...I’m not going to make you sleep on the floor of your own room.
lines.zh: : Ayane……我不会让你睡你自己房间的地板。

lines.en: : Can I...at least talk to you on the phone while you walk home? I don’t want you to leave yet. I’m still sad.
lines.zh: : 我至少能……在你走回家路上跟你讲电话吗？我还不想让你走。我还是难过。

lines.en: : If that's what you want, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果那是你想要的，行。

lines.en: : You can call me whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以打给我。

lines.en: : That's not true. If I called you whenever I wanted, you’d never be able to put down the phone.
lines.zh: : 那不是真的。我要是随时打给你，你永远别想放下电话。

lines.en: : Fair. You can definitely call me tonight, though.
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过今晚你肯定可以打给我。

lines.en: : Okay...Then...I’ll call you as soon as you leave.
lines.zh: : 好……那么……你一走我就打给你。

lines.en: : Works for me. And sorry I couldn’t spend the night tonight. But maybe some other time.
lines.zh: : 行。还有抱歉今晚不能留宿。不过也许改天。
: 也许改天。

lines.en: : I love you, [ayanemaster]. You don’t have to say it back.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，[ayanemaster]。你不用回我。

lines.en: I walk up to Ayane to say goodbye and she wraps her arms around me, but doesn’t squeeze with the same amount of enthusiasm she normally does.
lines.zh: 我走到 Ayane 跟前道别，她张开手臂抱住我，却不像平时那样用同样的热情收紧。

lines.en: I leave the room and receive a phone call before I even get back to the street.
lines.zh: 我走出房间，还没回到街上就接到了一通电话。

lines.en: Ayane falls asleep mid-conversation less than five minutes later.
lines.zh: 不到五分钟，Ayane 在通话中途睡着了。

lines.en: It never ceases to amaze me how tired you can get from crying.
lines.zh: 人哭一场能累成这样，永远让我惊叹。
Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！

I head to the library to hang out with Futaba.
lines.zh: 我去图书馆跟 Futaba 待着。

lines.en: When I get there, she waves me over to a table and immediately starts talking about some book she’s been reading.
lines.zh: 我到了之后，她把我招到一张桌边，立刻开始讲她最近在读的某本书。

lines.en: It’s surprisingly cute to see how excited she gets when discussing it.
lines.zh: 看她聊起那个有多兴奋，意外地挺可爱。

lines.en: And even as someone who doesn’t particularly like reading, I can feel myself getting wrapped up in her description.
lines.zh: 而就算我是个不怎么喜欢读书的人，我也能感觉到自己被她的描述吸引进去。

lines.en: She’s so much different alone than she is in class.
lines.zh: 她一个人的时候，跟在班上完全不一样。

lines.en: I hope that some day she's able to act like this around everyone else as well...
lines.zh: 我希望有朝一日，她也能在其他人面前这样……

I walk over to the soccer field to see how Miku and the rest of the team are doing.

lines.en: She notices me right away and runs up to me with the same level of excitement as always.
lines.zh: 她立刻注意到我，像往常一样兴奋地朝我跑过来。

lines.en: I thought her enthusiasm might have died down a bit after I became the coach, but it's become easily apparent that this is not the case.
lines.zh: 我本以为我当上教练之后，她那股热情会消退一点，不过现在显而易见并非如此。

lines.en: Regardless, I take a seat on the sidelines and watch as a group of attractive and fit [teenage]girls kick a ball around.

Once again, I find myself killing time at the cafe with Rin.
lines.zh: 我又一次在咖啡厅跟 Rin 一起打发时间。

lines.en: She takes my order and promptly discards it before dumping a bunch of random ingredients into a cup and handing it over.
lines.zh: 她接了我的单，随即把单子丢掉，往杯子里倒了一堆随机配料，然后递给我。

lines.en: Despite my initial skepticism, it actually tastes pretty good and I finish the entire thing.
lines.zh: 尽管我一开始挺怀疑，它其实味道不错，我整杯都喝完了。

lines.en: Rin smiles from ear to ear and tells me that she can't wait to rub this in her manager's face.
lines.zh: Rin 笑得合不拢嘴，说她等不及要拿这事去她经理面前显摆。

lines.en: Things get busy and I wind up having to leave before the two of us can start up a new conversation, but at least we managed to get a little bit closer.
lines.zh: 店里忙起来，我得在我俩开启新话题之前离开，不过至少我们还是亲近了一点。

lines.zh: Rin 今天不上班，于是我改跟 Haruka 聊。

lines.en: "We make idle chat about a few random things, but wind up spending the bulk of the conversation

聊 Rin 本人。

lines.en: It seems like Haruka might be even more worried about her than I am.
lines.zh: 看起来 Haruka 可能比我还要担心她。

lines.en: I hope everything turns out okay. My mornings just aren't the same without the rush brought on by coffee-roulette.
lines.zh: 希望一切都会好起来。没有咖啡轮盘赌带来的那股劲儿，我的早晨都不一样了。

lines.en: Haruka tells me that she'll let Rin know I dropped by the next time she sees her.
lines.zh: Haruka 告诉我，下次她见到 Rin 会跟她说我来看过。

lines.en: I should keep checking back until my normal barista is on her feet again...
lines.zh: 我该一直回去看看，直到我那位常驻咖啡师重新站起来……
